missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Автобус' is nominative as the subject of 'приехал'. 'Точно вовремя' describes the punctual arrival.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Автобус' is the accusative direct object of 'ждём'. As an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative form. 'Последний' is the agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Автобуса' is genitive after 'из' to express getting out of the bus. 'Здесь' marks the stop.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Автобусом' is the instrumental expressing travel by bus. 'На работу' is the accusative destination.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Автобусе' uses the prepositional form after 'в' for static location. 'Много людей' is the genitive plural count.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Автобусу' takes the dative after 'к' to mean running toward the bus. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Автобуса' takes the genitive singular after 'два'. 'На остановке' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Автобусы' is nominative plural as the subject of 'опаздывают'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'сегодня' adds the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Автобуса' is genitive linking to 'окно' to mean a window of the bus. 'Нового' agrees in the masculine genitive.

missions.phrase: Мы сели в автобус и поехали.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Автобус' takes the accusative after 'в' to express boarding the bus. 'Поехали' continues the action with 'и'.
